text:
agnes: quick sync - we need to decide what to ship for the observability sprint. big asks: per-model cost, better error slicing, lightweight trace hooks, and sampling controls.

tom: can we do a customer-impact vs dev-effort pass? pluck highest-impact quick wins first.

sara: list of asks from sales: (A) per-model token+infra cost, (B) error slices by route/model with counts, (C) trace span for model routing, (D) sampling toggle per-route. two enterprise deals blocked on A.

liam: infra note: we can emit per-token counters in metrics pipeline in ~48-72h. linking to billing calc will take longer.

neha: runtime changes for tracing hooks are tiny (span annotations + model tags). UI to surface traces is the time sink. estimate runtime 1d, UI 4d.

zoe: alerting/retention concern: if we increase trace volume, SRE needs retention and alert thresholds. suggest default 24h for self-serve, 30d opt-in for enterprise.

agnes: propose acceptance criteria + fallback for a 2-week scoped push. please react with :+1: if you agree or suggest cuts.

```
Acceptance criteria - observability sprint (proposal)
- Per-model counters (MVP): token counts per model & route in metrics + simple console table for 7d
  - AC: token counts emitted and queryable; table links to route detail
  - Fallback: show token counts only (no infra cost calc)
- Error slicing (MVP): aggregated error counts grouped by route/model; top 10 slices
  - AC: filterable by timeframe and model
  - Fallback: show top error messages as list with counts
- Trace hook (MVP): emit span on model selection + inference timing; include `model.name` and `model.variant`
  - AC: spans show up in traces in <5s; no PII in tags
  - Fallback: emit timing metric only
- Sampling (MVP): global sampling toggle in console (Off/10/50/100%) with rollout config
  - AC: toggle takes effect within 10min for most routes
  - Fallback: default sampling backend only (no UI per-route)
```

agnes: dev owners? tom/zoe can you own UI bits; liam/neha dev infra/runtime. sara will validate with customers.

tom: will create tickets and wire mock table. prefer to ship token counters + basic table first.

sara: i'll confirm with customers what is must-have vs nice-to-have - pushing A as must-have.

liam: privacy check - model ids ok, but no prompt text or PII in spans. neha please add sanitation step.

neha: noted. we'll strip prompt content from any span attributes.

deops-bot: rollout: branch `obs-sprint-v1` created (neha). CI checks queued.

zoe: adding SRE requirement: default alerting disabled for new traces until retention and sampling stable. document in runbook.

agnes: final plan for 2-week box: 1) per-model token counters + simple table, 2) trace hook runtime + tags, 3) global sampling toggle UI, 4) error-slice UI + cost calc as stretch. shipping note to customers needed. sara please own comms.

sara: will send a crisp note: what ships in week1, what is stretch, fallback behavior, and expected timeline. aim EOD tomorrow.

agnes: thanks all. we'll re-evaluate during the Thursday roadmap sync and lock tickets.
